newsitem.title: GERMANY: Hannover Re to up capital in rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Hannover Re to up capital in rights issue.

text.p: German reinsurance group Hannover Rueckversicherungs AG on Thursday said it would offer shareholders 807,664 new shares at 56 marks each to raise its capital by four million marks to around 145.4 million.

The reinsurer, the world's fifth largest, said in a statement that the offer would run from October 29 through November 12. The new shares would be fully entitled to dividends for the 1996 business year.
Hannover Re's shares closed on Thursday at 66 marks.
The company said the move altered its traditional dividend policy, and would mean a three mark payout on 1995 earnings per five-mark nominal value share.
Instead of allocating part of its 1995 available payout of 70 million marks to its reserves, as was its usual practice, 45 million marks was being returned to shareholders, Hannover Re said.
Hannover Re said this practice would be continued in the future. Its chairman Wilhelm Zeller said the dividend payout should rise to 100 million marks by the year 2000.
